The case creates a virtual catalog, a control store on it and one category with a slug; only a RESOLVING permalink is sent to slugInfo (a missing permalink would write a broken link).
Steps:
[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP vcat]
POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/catalogs
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"name": "AGENT-TEST-SEOX-VC", "isVirtual": true, "languages": [{"languageCode": "{{CULTURE_NAME}}", "isDefault": true}]}
[REST-EXEC vcat]
[REST-CAPTURE vcat.body.id → VCAT]
[REST-OP ctrl]
POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"id": "AGENT-TEST-SEOX-CTRL-{{VCAT}}", "name": "AGENT-TEST-SEOX-CTRL-{{VCAT}}", "catalog": "{{VCAT}}", "storeState": "Open", "defaultLanguage": "{{CULTURE_NAME}}", "languages": ["{{CULTURE_NAME}}"], "defaultCurrency": "{{CURRENCY_CODE}}", "currencies": ["{{CURRENCY_CODE}}"]}
[REST-EXEC ctrl]
[REST-CAPTURE ctrl.body.id → CTRL_ID]
[REST-OP cata]
POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/categories
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"catalogId": "{{VCAT}}", "name": "AGENT-TEST-SEOX-CATA", "code": "seox-a-{{VCAT}}", "seoInfos": [{"semanticUrl": "agent-test-seox-cons-{{VCAT}}", "languageCode": "{{CULTURE_NAME}}", "isActive": true, "objectType": "Category"}]}
[REST-EXEC cata]
[REST-CAPTURE cata.body.id → CATA]
[REST-CAPTURE cata.body.seoInfos.0.id → CATA_SEO]
[REST-OP cata_get]
GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/categories/{{CATA}}
[REST-EXEC cata_get]
[REST-CAPTURE cata_get.body.seoInfos.0.semanticUrl → CATA_SLUG]
[REST-OP ex]
GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/seoinfos/explain?storeId={{CTRL_ID}}&storeDefaultLanguage={{CULTURE_NAME}}&languageCode={{CULTURE_NAME}}&permalink={{CATA_SLUG}}
[REST-EXEC ex]
[GQL-OP slug]
query { slugInfo(permalink: "{{CATA_SLUG}}", storeId: "{{CTRL_ID}}", cultureName: "{{CULTURE_NAME}}") { entityInfo { id objectId objectType semanticUrl } redirectUrl } }
[GQL-EXEC slug]
